messages.subject: linking tabs within shiny dashboard
parts:
I have items in separate shiny dashboard "tabItem" that I would like to make a link between them as follows:

menuItem("Introduction", tabName = "Introduction", icon = icon("fa fa-info")),
menuItem("Differennt section", tabName = "Different_section", icon = icon("fa fa-info"))

tabItem("Introduction", tags$h4("Introduction", id="intro"))


tabItem("Different_section", tags$a(href="#intro",target="_Introduction", "Go to Introduction"))

However doing it this way makes a new tab open in the browser. I would like it to go to the link and stay in the same tab...

I tried specifying the target as self and a bunch of other things (as below) to make the tab stay constant but nothing happens.

tags$a(href="#intro",target="_self", "Go to Introduction")

The fact that the entities are in separate tabItems blocks me from linking them in a way that I can go to them in the same tab...
How do I get around this?
Thanks
